subject: general
question: Which of the following places is known for its hot springs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaurikund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gaurikund**

 
 
• One of the **holiest places** for Hindus is the hot spring of **Gaurikund**.
 
• It is situated on the banks of the **Mandakini River** and is approximately **2040 metres** above sea level.
 
• The spring is located in the **Garhwal Himalayas** at a height of roughly **6,000 feet**.
 
• Gaurikund, which is surrounded by breathtaking views, is where the well-known** trek** to the **Kedarnath temple** begins.
 
• It is thought that bathing in the holy water of the pond will **purify a person's soul**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

 
• **Mawsynram**

 
 
• It is located in the **northeastern Indian** state of Meghalaya's **East Khasi Hills area**.
 
• Mawsynram is known for being the **wettest place on earth**.
 
• It has a **Guinness World Record** for having nearly **26,000 mm** of rainfall in one year, **1985**.
 
 
 
• **Jaisalmer**
 
 
• It is located in the Indian state of **Rajasthan** and is also known as **"The Golden City."**
 
• Jaisalmer is well-known for its **majestic Jaisalmer fort** that encircles the city.
 
 
 
• **Coorg**
 
 
• Coorg commonly referred to as **Kodagu**, is located in the Indian state of** Karnataka**.
 
• It is known for its **coffee plantations**, diversity of** flora and fauna, ****rocky terrain, and spectacular views.**
